name: Fenton
text: Fenton is a village and civil parish in the West Lindsey district of Lincolnshire, England. It is situated 9 mi (14 km) north-west of Lincoln and 4 miles (6.4 km) west from Saxilby. The population of the civil parish was 297 at the 2001 census, increasing to 353 at the 2011 census.

depictions.name: Fenton
depictions.text: Fenton (died 870s) was a male sheep that belonged to a Suthsexe farmer in the 9th century.
